bias.zh: 短线偏空 · 上市时间短

read.en: The Nasdaq ADS has only 65 sessions of history since its July listing, so the 100-day average is not available. It fell 13% in five sessions and closed below its 5, 10 and 30-day averages. MACD has been below its signal since Sep 28 with a widening histogram, Parabolic SAR turned bearish on Oct 7, and RSI is 42.
read.zh: 纳斯达克 ADS 自 7月上市仅 65 个交易日，尚无 100 日均线。五个交易日下跌 13%，收盘跌破 5 日、10 日和 30 日均线。MACD 自 9月28日起位于信号线下方且柱体扩大，抛物线 SAR 于 10月7日转空，RSI 为 42。

read.en: Resistance is $177–181 (the 30-day average and July–September pivots), then $196–200 (September highs). Support is $160, a July pivot, then $151.5 and $146. Switch to the Seoul listing above for the longer trend.
read.zh: 阻力在 $177–181（30 日均线及7–9月转折点），其次 $196–200（9月高点）。支撑为 7月转折点 $160，其下 $151.5 与 $146。如需观察更长周期趋势，可切换至上方的首尔上市股票。

bias.zh: 短线偏空 · 位于100日均线下方

read.en: In Seoul, SK Hynix closed at ₩1,681,000 on Oct 8 (the market was shut on Oct 9 for Hangul Day). It is 44% below the June 24 record of ₩2,987,000 and down 23% over three months. Price is below the 5, 10 and 30-day averages and the 100-day (₩1,936,000), though the 200-day (₩1,441,000) is still rising. MACD crossed down on Oct 5, Parabolic SAR has been above price since Sep 28, and RSI is 44.
read.zh: 首尔市场方面，SK 海力士 10月8日收于 ₩1,681,000（10月9日韩文节休市）。股价较 6月24日纪录高点 ₩2,987,000 低 44%，三个月下跌 23%。股价位于 5 日、10 日、30 日均线及 100 日均线（₩1,936,000）下方，但 200 日均线（₩1,441,000）仍在上行。MACD 于 10月5日死叉，抛物线 SAR 自 9月28日起位于股价上方，RSI 为 44。

read.en: The stock is at the bottom of its 20-day range (₩1,671,000). Losing that level points to ₩1,558,000 (the Sep 2 low) and then the 200-day average near ₩1,441,000. A recovery needs a close back above ₩1,752,000 (30-day average), then ₩1,837,000, which capped five swings in September.
